newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares firm at open, Creative rises.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares firm at open, Creative rises.

text.p: Singapore shares were firm at the open on Wednesday but trading remained quiet.
"There is not much activity. Sentiment is a bit better all round because the Fed did not raise rates but market interest is still thin," said a broker with a local firm.

Creative Technology continued to surge following overnight gains on Nasdaq. After half an hour of trading, it was up Singapore $1.35 (US$0.96) to S$9.10 with 272,950 shares traded. "The stock is still trailing the U.S. closing price which works out to be about S$9.50," said a dealer.
The broader market was lacklustre with a thin volume of 12.7 million shares traded. Gainers were 59 against 16 losers.
The Straits Times Industrial Index was up 4.92 points to 2,165.19.
Property-based United Industrial Corp was the most active with the bulk of its volume of 2.8 million units married at S$1.24.
Early gainers include Great Eastern Life, Fraser & Neave and SIA foreign while Jurong Cement, Robinson and Scotts Holdings were lower.
